name: FUN_WF_ROUTING_INSTANCES
description: This table contains details of rule evaluation service like execution time, routing results or error if any. Rule evaluation is a critical activity in approval flow where telemetry data needs to be gathered.

columns.name: INSTANCE_ID
columns.description: INSTANCE_ID is the primary identifier to track the request.

columns.name: TRACE_ID
columns.description: TRACE_ID is the unique ID to correlate the logs for the flow.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: TRANSACTION_ID is the transaction identifier for which the rules are being executed.

columns.name: WORKFLOW_ID
columns.description: WORKFLOW_ID is the identifier for workflow for which the request is made.

columns.name: EXECUTION_MODE
columns.description: EXECUTION_MODE is the mode in which the rule engine is executed i.e., from SOA for approval, or a REST API call for rule simulation.

columns.name: INVOCATION_TIME
columns.description: INVOCATION_TIME is the time when the request is made.

columns.name: START_TIME
columns.description: START_TIME is the time when the request actually started processing.

columns.name: COMPLETION_TIME
columns.description: COMPLETION_TIME is the time when the request got completed.

columns.name: RESPONSE_RECEIPT_TIME
columns.description: RESPONSE_RECEIPT_TIME is the time when response was received at BPEL layer.

columns.name: RESPONSE
columns.description: RESPONSE is list of actions of the matched rules for given transaction.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: ERROR_MESSAGE is the error occurred during rule evaluation.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_PARAMETERS
columns.description: ADDITIONAL_PARAMETERS is the field to capture identifiers for the bulk submission and name/value pair of runtime processing parameters in a JSON string format.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
